description:
Sri Venkateswara Mahatyam Full Length Movie Telugu. NTR's #SriVenkateswaraMahatyam is a Telugu Language Hindu Mythological Film. Based on Avatar of Lord Venkateswara (Balaji). Directed by P. Pullaiah. Starring N.T. Rama Rao, S. Varalakshmi, Savitri, V. Nagayya, Gummadi, Relangi, Ramana Reddy, Rajanala, Vangara, Valluri Balakrishna, Peketi Sivaram, Ghantasala, and others. Produced by V. Venkateswarlu, under Padmasri Pictures Banner. Music Composed by Pendyala Nageswara Rao. The film was dubbed into Tamil and released as Srinivasa Kalyanam. It released with twenty prints and had a 100-day run in 16 centers and 175 days in Hyderabad and Vijayawada centers. The deification of Rama Rao began and his residence in Madras became a shrine for pilgrims, who would visit him after a trip to Tirupati. NTR fans waited in long queues outside his house for a darshan of their "living god". They used to apprise him of their problems back home in their villages and he listened to them patiently before rushing to the studio in the morning. Watch and Experience the timeless devotional grandeur of " SRI VENKATESWARA MAHATYAM ", This film beautifully brings to life the divine glory and mythology associated with Lord Venkateswara.
